title: SE4 day-ahead auction prices (hourly until 2025-09-30, 15-minute afterwards).
transformation_notes: timestamp_utc = start of the SDAC day-ahead product (UTC); resolution_minutes = 60 until delivery day 2025-09-30 and 15 from 2025-10-01 (SDAC 15-minute MTU go-live).
price_eur_mwh is float32; null prices dropped; duplicates on timestamp_utc dropped (last kept).

Hourly rows come from Elspotprices (SpotPriceEUR) before 2025-09-30T22:00Z, 15-minute rows from DayAheadPrices (DayAheadPriceEUR) afterwards; requests are filtered to PriceArea in ['DK1', 'DK2', 'SE3', 'SE4'] and to the EUR columns.
note: Test fixture sliced from data/public/nordic/da_prices_SE4.parquet by scripts/research/nordic_make_fixtures.py
